checks.name: static_torque_saturation
checks.note: H1 [favorable bounds]: holding the shallowest planned crouch (knee 0.8 rad) needs left_knee 15.7 of 139.0 N*m (0.11x). Reference crouch (hip -0.8, knee 1.5): 0.20x; deep crouch (hip -1.2, knee 2.0): 0.26x of forcerange [left_knee 36.3/139.0 N*m]. Passing proves nothing; simplified model, needs precise validation.

checks.name: takeoff_energy
checks.note: H2/H3 [favorable bounds]: needs net takeoff work m*g*h = 48.3 J; max-effort upper bound 1.25 x integral of (F_max(pose) - m*g) over a 0.32 m crouch stroke = 684.0 J (F_max = weight / static torque ratio, torque scale 1.00). Neglects limb dynamics and upper-body swing beyond the allowance - simplified model, needs precise validation.

checks.name: landing_deceleration
checks.note: H5 pre-check [favorable bounds]: stopping from v_td = 1.72 m/s within the 0.32 m leg stroke needs mean 1.48 BW; limit = min(assumed structural limit 12.0 BW, mean leg force capability 17.79 BW).

agent_steps.label: CMA-ES search
agent_steps.summary: Witness found after 600 evaluations (5.8 s, 1 seed attempt(s)).

agent_steps.label: Monte-Carlo over assumptions
agent_steps.summary: Nominal optimum succeeds in 27/200 sampled assumption sets; failures: {'ACTUATOR_SATURATION': 100, 'CONTACT_LOSS': 23, 'STRUCTURAL_UNMODELED': 17, 'TIPPING': 33}.

agent_steps.summary: Second CMA-ES stage on 10 perturbed models (3530 evals): held-out MC p 0.14 -> 0.09; nominal optimum kept.

agent_steps.label: Export replay trajectory

agent_steps.summary: (from the x0.4 torque variant run) Smallest feasible tested torque_scale: 0.5 x G1 forcerange (p_success 0%, verified by Monte-Carlo after 1 sweep variant(s)).

param_bounds.name: crouch_hip
param_bounds.description: hip-pitch angle at crouch bottom (neg = thigh forward)

param_bounds.description: knee flexion for landing (leg stroke / compliance)

success_criteria.name: jump_height
success_criteria.description: Ballistic height vz^2/(2g) of the whole-body COM at liftoff

success_criteria.name: stable_landing
success_criteria.description: Lands on both feet, torso upright (z-axis >= 0.8), pelvis >= 0.35 m, no non-foot ground contact

success_criteria.name: horizontal_drift
success_criteria.description: Horizontal COM travel between start and touchdown ('straight up'); default

success_criteria.name: landing_grf
success_criteria.description: Peak vertical ground-reaction force from first touchdown contact, in body weights

control.label: Motor torque scale
control.hint: Multiplier on the Unitree G1 actuator torque limits in the MuJoCo Menagerie model (knee 139, hip 88-139, ankle 50 N*m at x1.0). Low values violate a necessary condition (takeoff energy) = strong 'impossible'; mid values: the search finds no jump in budget = WEAK 'not found'; high values: a stable jump is found. Each value is a separate seeded run (seed 20260002); the landing peak-force limit (9 BW) is an unverified default.

verdict.summary: Impossible within the stated assumptions: 'takeoff_energy' requires 48.25 J but at most 11.94 J is available, even at the favorable end of the assumptions (shortfall factor 4.04x). [ENERGY_BUDGET] H2/H3 [favorable bounds]: needs net takeoff work m*g*h = 48.3 J. Simplified model, needs precise validation.

necessary_checks.name: landing_deceleration
necessary_checks.note: H5 pre-check [favorable bounds]: stopping from v_td = 1.72 m/s within the 0.02 m leg stroke needs mean 8.70 BW; limit = min(assumed structural limit 12.0 BW, mean leg force capability 4.93 BW).

suggested_fix.rationale: Optimizer sweep of torque_scale over [0.2, 0.35, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8, 1.0] x G1 forcerange (tested ascending) found the smallest tested value with a verified feasible variant: 0.1 -> 0.5 x G1 forcerange; Monte-Carlo p_success 0% (n=200, 4550 evaluations). Fragile: it works in fewer than half of the sampled assumption sets. Found by search; not unique; the grid is coarse, so the true minimum may lie between tested values.
